big: A deposit pays 6.5%. Inflation runs at 5%. It feels like a 6.5% gain. In real terms it is about 1.5%, and less after tax. The number on the receipt is not the number in your pocket.

lines: My FD gives 6.5%. That is a good return, right?
Subtract inflation. Real return is nominal return less inflation, so 6.5% less 5% is about 1.5%. Tax takes more. Always read the real number.

note: Figures as per the lesson text. Check current releases. FY27 inflation is projected near 5%.
